title: a document becomes a coverage plan and a board, for nothing
question: do genesis plan, genesis pack, cookbook check/run and mainboard gaps all run locally?
rule: README: `bb genesis plan` reports what nothing covers, ranked and tiered; `bb genesis pack` writes one small brief per surface.
`bb cookbook check` validates every corpus with no server and no requests.
`bb mainboard gaps` names the first pipeline stage that does not hold, and its fix.

steps.name: the plan reports coverage against the world
pack writes the briefs without sending one
the corpus validates with no server
steps.run: node bin/bb.js cookbook check && node bin/bb.js cookbook run --help >/dev/null; true

steps.name: the board names the first stage that does not hold
